items.exampleEn: The teacher illustrated the idea with a simple story.
items.exampleZh: 老師用一個簡單的故事來說明這個概念。

items.exampleEn: She finally confronted her neighbor about the loud music.
items.exampleZh: 她終於為了吵鬧的音樂去當面找鄰居談。

items.exampleEn: The door swung open in the wind.
The papers were bound together with string.
items.exampleZh: 這些文件用繩子綁在一起。

items.exampleEn: She manages her time very effectively.
items.exampleZh: 她非常有效地管理時間。

items.exampleEn: I pressed too hard, and the pencil snapped in two.
items.exampleZh: 我太用力了，鉛筆啪的一聲斷成兩截。

items.exampleEn: Bring your camping gear; we'll stay two nights.
items.exampleZh: 帶上你的露營裝備；我們會待兩晚。

items.exampleEn: Could you sweep the kitchen floor?
items.exampleZh: 你可以掃一下廚房地板嗎？

items.sentenceEn: The cleaner sweeps the office floors every evening.
items.sentenceZh: 清潔人員每天傍晚打掃辦公室的地板。

items.audioEn: The branch snapped under the weight of the snow, but nobody was hurt.
items.audioZh: 樹枝被積雪壓斷了，但沒有人受傷。

items.sentenceEn: We need to work together more effectively as a team.
items.sentenceZh: 我們團隊需要更有效地合作。

items.sentenceEn: My daughter loves to swing as high as she can.
items.sentenceZh: 我女兒喜歡把鞦韆盪得越高越好。

items.stemEn: The speaker showed old photos to ____ how the city had changed.
items.stemZh: 講者用老照片來說明這座城市的變化。

items.stemEn: Instead of avoiding your boss, you should ____ him about the problem.
items.stemZh: 與其躲著老闆，你應該當面跟他談這個問題。

items.passageEn: Last weekend, my friends and I went camping in the mountains. We packed all our gear into one car. When we arrived, the wind was strong, and the trees were swinging wildly. Setting up the tent was hard: one of the poles snapped, so we had to bind it with tape. Our leader, Andy, invariably stays calm in situations like this. He believes you should confront problems instead of running from them, and he solved each one effectively. In the evening, he drew a simple map in the dirt to illustrate the next day's route. The next morning, we swept the ground clean before we left.
items.passageZh: 上週末，我和朋友們去山上露營。我們把所有裝備塞進一台車。抵達時風很大，樹木劇烈搖晃。搭帳篷很辛苦：有一根支架啪地斷了，我們只好用膠帶把它綁起來。我們的領隊 Andy 遇到這種情況總是很冷靜。他認為遇到問題應該面對，而不是逃避，而他也有效地解決了每個問題。晚上，他在地上畫了一張簡單的地圖，說明隔天的路線。隔天早上，我們離開前把營地掃乾淨。

questions.questionZh: 帳篷的支架斷了，他們怎麼辦？

options: 在地上畫地圖說明隔天的路線
帶大家去附近散步、看星星

items.promptZh: 她用一張圖表說明銷售額的變化。
referenceEn: She used a chart to illustrate the changes in sales.
She illustrated the change in sales with a chart.
rubricZh: illustrate 表示「（用例子、圖表）說明」，例如 use…to illustrate…、illustrate…with… 等
「銷售額的變化」可寫，例如 the changes in sales、how sales changed 等；過去式或現在式都可以

items.promptZh: 這座城市必須面對交通越來越擁擠的問題。
referenceEn: The city must confront the problem of growing traffic.
The city has to confront its traffic problem, which is getting worse.
rubricZh: confront 後面接要面對的問題（例如 confront the problem 等）
「必須」可寫，例如 must、has to、needs to 等
「交通越來越擁擠」可寫，例如 growing traffic、traffic is getting worse 等
